detail:
- **Documented**: 37 of 37 modules carry an author's summary

label: organisms
quotes: BarSeries
BarSeries is a chart organism component that renders a bar series with animated reveal and formatted numeric labels.
Bars
A visual component that renders bar-based graphical elements, likely used for charts or UI indicators, with no additional requirements documented yet.
Blobs
A visual component that renders decorative animated or static blob shapes within the UI.
BlockTitle
Renders the title text of a block.
CardList
A minimal UI module providing a CardList component with no recorded requirements beyond its presence.
Closing
The Closing module represents the UI component responsible for presenting a closing screen, though no detailed requirements have been recorded yet.
Cover
Documented the Cover module as a presentational component, with no existing requirements and no area classification inferred from the limited declaration data.
Cycle
Cycle is a module with no recorded requirements, providing no further detail beyond a placeholder declaration of the same name.
Deck
The Deck module implements the Deck organism component that assembles and navigates between slides in a presentation, wiring up theme toggling and stop/mark navigation via useDeckNavigation.
useDeckNavigation
A React hook that implements deck navigation, computing the active slide position and helper lookups like reduced, photoOf, box, and nameOf for a presentation deck.
DeckFooter
The Deck footer module defines the DeckFooter component, a UI element rendered at the bottom of a deck/slide view.
Dumbbell
Dumbbell is a chart component that renders a dumbbell-style data visualization, formatting and signing its values and reacting to reveal and numeric formatting state.
